messages:
Erin: heads up — multiple multi-GPU training jobs in us-west-2 (gpu-scalepool-3) started hitting NCCL stalls around 10:12 PDT. Allreduce p99 latency spiked, some jobs fell back to single-GPU. Any recent infra changes?

Sam: I saw the same alerts. No kernel rollout on our side in the window per deploy logs. @devops-bot can you confirm any switch firmware or config pushes last night?

devops-bot: no scheduled ToR firmware changes between 02:00-12:00 PDT. Automated config drift check: no host MTU changes detected in CM DB.

Erin: quick outputs (sanitized):
```
# on gpu-node-23
$ ip link show dev eth0
3: eth0: mtu 9000 qdisc mq state UP mode DEFAULT group default qlen 1000
$ ethtool -S mlx5_0 | grep drop
   rx_drops: 38
   rx_fragments: 6
$ /sbin/ibv_devinfo -v | head -n 3
   hca_id: mlx5_0
   vendor_id: 0x15b3
```
Also tcpdump (filtered) shows UDP fragments and intermittent ICMP "fragmentation needed" coming from the ToR for RoCEv2 flows.

Maria: ICMP frag-needed suggests a PMTU mismatch somewhere. If ECMP rebalances across two different MTU-capable paths you'll see this. Can you try: `ping -M do -s 8972 <peer_ip>` (with DF) to confirm?

Erin: ran that with DF — it fails with "Frag needed". Without DF, packets fragment and NCCL throughput tanks. `ip route get <peer_ip>` alternates next-hop between leaf-a and leaf-b.

Kai: this smells like asymmetric ECMP + MTU mismatch. Also note that LRO/GRO/GSO with mlx5 can hide fragmentation until the NIC hands up fragments, leading to rx_fragments count. Try turning off offloads on a test node: `ethtool -K eth0 gro off gso off tso off` and retest RDMA tests (ibv_rc_pingpong / nccl-tests).

Sam: also verify `sysctl net.ipv4.conf.all.rp_filter` (we had rp_filter cause trouble previously with asymmetric routes). RoCEv2 is UDP-based so if switches rewrite checksums or tags it can get dropped. Check ToR ECMP hash config — UDP port hashing could be sending fragments down a different path.

Erin: did the offload toggle on gpu-node-23: `gro/gso/tso` off. After that `ethtool -S` shows `rx_fragments: 0` and `ibv_rc_pingpong` stable for 15m. Reproduced on 2 more nodes — promising.

Maria: action items: 1) cluster-wide audit of host MTU (ensure 9000 everywhere); 2) enforce a CM policy so people don't change MTU to 9216 ad-hoc; 3) check ToR ECMP hash firmware for a known bug that reorders/redistributes UDP fragments; 4) add udev rule to disable GRO/GSO on mlx5 hosts as a short-term mitigation.

Kai: long-term we should prefer path MTU consistency + switch fix. Also look into enabling UDP fragmentation offload features on switches or enabling HW reassembly patches (some firmware versions have fixes). Will coordinate with net-team.

Sam: for immediate mitigation we can push a small playbook to disable GRO/GSO on all prod GPU hosts and roll canaries. We should also add a healthcheck for `rx_fragments>0` counter to alert earlier.

infra-oncall: opened INC-45321 and tagged net-team + infra. Scheduling a 2hr maintenance window at 03:00 UTC to roll ToR firmware on affected racks and push udev/playbook to hosts. Sam/Maria/Kai assigned. I'll attach rollback steps and test checklist. :calendar: :wrench:

Erin: thanks — will run nccl-tests canaries once the first rack is done. Keep me posted. :thumbsup:
